sections.text: Introduction

This document outlines the equipment inspection 
I1, to be performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.

The function of this engineer station is to review and update all the software 
files of DCS system
The engineer station consists of:
MSP card, processor for CRT, Part # ( 772B388G57) .
MSP card, processor for printer, Part # (772B388G29)
MSP card, processor for keyboard , Part # (772B388G56)
MDM card, memory card, Part # (7381A81G01)
MHC card, data highway controller card, Part # (7381A93G01)
Disk controller card, Part # (405A689G03)

MMI power supply, input :220VAC,output:+12VDC,+ 5VDC, part # 
(4D33613G02)
Disk drive assembly W/floppy drive (80MB), part # (3D04153G08)
2 Cooling fan, 230VAC, 14 Watt, part # (2450D25G03)

Safety Precautions

A work permit must be 
issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety 
category (using ground strap)

The online maintenance work 
on the engineer station cabinet must not affect the operation status of the plant.

Make a backup of software 
before work if it is required.

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out

items: Check the back up software for the cabinet.

Check the cabinet status by using (system 
 status display) diagram.

Check the operation of network card function 
 (data highway controller card (MHC) by using (system highway errors 
 diagram).
Clean all cabinet cards from dust by blower.

Check the operation of cabinet cooling fan 
 for (noise temp.).

- If any LED of three output voltage LEDS
 OFF that is means the power supply is failure 
 and must be replaced

Check the operation of hard disk by using key 
 switch on config mode.
Check the performance of operator keyboard.
Check the performance of engineer keyboard.
Clean the printer.
Check the operation of printer.
Check the configuration program for printer.

Check the two cooling fans operation, and 
 check the sound & temperature.
